questions.question: Is the main subject clearly an animated SVG explainer showing an AI agent, the Webex MCP Server as the central orchestration hub, and business outcomes in a capability orbit?
Does the 12-second animation send intent into the MCP hub, activate outbound connectors sequentially, and finish with success indicators while explanatory text remains stationary?
Is the setting a self-contained 1600x900 deep-navy SVG with generous margins, a separated AI agent, a central MCP hub, and six non-overlapping outcome nodes?
Is the framing flat and orthographic with consistent geometry, large system-sans typography, short capability tags, no perspective, and no element outside the viewBox?
Are blue, teal, cyan, and violet glows restrained and used to communicate active flow while text remains high contrast?

Does the image read as a premium enterprise infographic with crisp vector iconography, embedded CSS animation, reduced-motion support, semantic accessibility text, and no JavaScript or external fonts?
Is all visible text crisp, correctly spelled, non-garbled, fully contained, and free from collisions?
Is the image free of watermarks, copied logos, and signatures?
Are customer notifications, incident response rooms, customer account collaboration, access and lifecycle governance, event-driven automation, and knowledge and approvals all present?
Do those outcomes map respectively to Messages; Rooms and Memberships; Teams and Spaces; People and Memberships; Webhooks and Events; and ECM, Tabs, and Actions?
Is the irrelevant tool count absent from the image?
Are there no clipped labels, overflowing boxes, overlapping outcome groups, or elements outside the SVG canvas?
Does the visual hierarchy and outcome separation remain understandable in the inspected 800x450 README-width render?
Does prefers-reduced-motion disable all animations while leaving a complete and meaningful static composition?

note: Questions combine the media-image token parser with repository-specific business, layout, animation, and accessibility checks.
